hos-1-3.anchor: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

hos-4-8.anchor: set their heart on their iniquity

hos-5-4.anchor: They will not frame their doings

hos-6-10.anchor: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

hos-7-3.anchor: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

hos-8-2.anchor: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

hos-9-6.anchor: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles

hos-12-13.anchor: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

hos-13-7.anchor: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

hos-13-11.anchor: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.

hos-13-12.anchor: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
